title: cal trace --json
description: What `cal trace export` wrote (or, with --dry-run, would write): Agent Trace records (agent-trace.dev) for the commits the project's sessions produced.

schema_version.description: Major version of this payload's shape. A reader refuses a version newer than it knows.

specVersion.description: The Agent Trace version the records carry.

repo.description: The repository the commits were read from.

project.description: The project key whose sessions were exported.

out.description: Where the records go: a file, or `-` for stdout.

since.description: Only commits from this epoch second on (`--since DAYS`); null for all time.

records.description: Records built: one per session and linked commit whose files the session edited.

written.description: Records appended to `out` (0 on a dry run or to stdout).

alreadyPresent.description: Records `out` already had (same id), left as they were.

skippedLinks.description:
Session-commit links skipped because the session edited none of the commit's files
(linked through mentions alone, or indexed before file edits were recorded).

missingCommits.description: Linked commits the repository no longer has (rebased away, or another clone's).

oversizedCommits.description:
Commits whose diff was past the 8 MiB bound (a vendored lockfile or data dump): their
records name the files without line ranges.
